audit.whatIsWrong: The page warns about Petrifying Gaze but never states the one thing that makes it decide the matchup: it stuns only enemies facing her, and Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the front.
audit.why: Riot's Petrifying Gaze text: 'stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.' Riot's Aegis Assault text: 'becoming invulnerable to damage from the front.' Your one damage-proof button requires the exact orientation her ultimate punishes, and any CC ends the channel. The mirror audit states the same interaction from her side.
audit.corrected: Facing her is what the block needs and what the stun wants — turn away from a 120s Petrifying Gaze, or do not channel at all.

audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma is described as grounding 'your W-leap and E-dash gap-close'. Aegis Assault is not a dash.
audit.why: Riot's Aegis Assault text is a stationary channel behind a shield. Pantheon's only Movement abilities are Shield Vault and Grand Starfall, so Miasma's grounding takes those two and nothing else. Riot's Miasma text: 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities', on 24/22/20/18/16.
audit.corrected: Grounding now stated against Shield Vault and Grand Starfall specifically, with Miasma's 24s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Serpentine Grace is called her 'no-boots passive move speed' in two strings.
audit.why: Riot's current text for Serpentine Grace is one line: 'All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.' There is no boot restriction in it. The kiting is real; the reason given for it is out of date.
audit.corrected: Described as Serpentine Grace amplifying her move speed bonuses.

audit.why: 8.5/10 with the chart giving Cassiopeia five of seven stages is the honest read even at 51.6% over 531 games — Pantheon's win rate here comes from map play with Grand Starfall, not from the lane. Early is a walk-up problem, mid is a grounding problem, side lane is unplayable into Rylai's.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the spike rows name only one ability.
audit.why: Miasma 24/22/20/18/16, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80, Noxious Blast 3.5s at 850, Twin Fang 0.75s. Miasma's 24s against Shield Vault's 13s is the sequencing: you get roughly two gap-closes per Miasma if you spend the first one baiting it.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes, cooldown block, dos and the interactions row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions anti-heal, yet Twin Fang heals her off every cast.
audit.why: Riot's Twin Fang text: it 'heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt', on a 0.75s cooldown against a poisoned target. _missing-interactions.json flags the same thing. Against a Pantheon who has to commit, that heal is the reason extended trades never close.
audit.corrected: Twin Fang's heal named in the 2-item spike; Grievous Wounds flagged in the audit for the itemisation row.

edits.before: Cassiopeia has no hard CC and one of the weakest level-1s in the game — abuse it. Your W is point-and-click so she cannot dodge the stun, and at levels 1-2 she has no poison stacks to punish you back, so walk up, W-stun into Q, and trade out. Dodge her Twin Fang follow-up by stepping sideways after your combo, and never sit in the poison cloud farming. At 3 you have E to block her Q/W poke entirely while you advance — this is your best clean kill window.
edits.after: Cassiopeia has no hard CC until 6 and one of the weakest level-1s in the game — abuse it. Shield Vault is a targeted leap she cannot dodge, and at 1-2 she has no Noxious Blast stacked to punish you, so walk up, W-stun into Q, and trade out. Never stand in a poison cloud farming: Twin Fang hits poisoned targets every 0.75s and heals her for it. At 3, face her and Aegis Assault blocks the poke while you advance.

edits.before: From 4-5 onward she stabilizes: her poison stacks now out-sustain your trades and she kites with her no-boots passive move speed. Save your E to eat her Twin Fang burst, but respect that she only needs to land W on you to ground your W-leap and E-dash, stranding your gap-close. At 6 her Petrifying Gaze flips the all-in — if you commit W and she face-stuns you, you are dead, so bait the R or only engage when it is down. Your Grand Starfall is better spent roaming to a side lane than dueling her here.
edits.after: From 4-5 she stabilizes: Twin Fang fires every 0.75s and heals her off your poison, and Serpentine Grace makes every move speed buff kite you harder. Miasma is the real problem — one cloud grounds you, and grounded you cannot cast Shield Vault or Grand Starfall at all, so bait its 24 seconds before you commit anything. At 6, Petrifying Gaze stuns whoever is facing her, which is exactly the turn Aegis Assault demands of you. Roam with Grand Starfall rather than duel her here.
